summary: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
key_events: Betrayal conflict: JULIANA: 'Now a church calls my marriage a lie!'

scene_analyses.key_conflict: Betrayal conflict: JULIANA: 'Now a church calls my marriage a lie!'
betrayals: JULIANA: 'Now a church calls my marriage a lie!'
HIGH PRIEST: 'God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!'
secrets_or_revelations: HIGH PRIEST: 'None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.'
HIGH PRIEST: 'And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.'
JULIANA: 'I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.'
threats_or_danger: HIGH PRIEST: 'The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.'
HIGH PRIEST: 'Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.'
HIGH PRIEST: 'And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!'
scene_analyses.narrative_summary: Scene EP46_SCENE_01 at INT. ASHBURTON ESTATE CHAPEL – CONTINUOUS involving ALEXANDER, CATHERINE, HIGH PRIEST, JULIANA.
